unavailable.latency_ms: No verifier latency is measured for this run: the marker publishes confidence_latency_ms only when the run's provider attempt was timed (#1455), and this record carries no published latency; the run-directory artifact confidence-score.json records no timing either.
unavailable.token_usage: The provider's usage is normalized by the transport and reaches the published marker only through the scorer's telemetry (confidence_prompt_tokens, confidence_completion_tokens, confidence_total_tokens, #1455); this record carries no published usage, so the raw run-directory artifact confidence-response.json remains the only home for it.
unavailable.rubric_version: The rubric version constant is written only into the run-directory artifact confidence-score.json; it reaches the published record only indirectly, through the config hash in the fingerprint marker.
unavailable.deterministic_caps: The deterministic ceilings are recorded as structured tokens only in the run-directory artifact confidence-score.json; the published reason carries at most the appended note that names them.
unavailable.parser_notes: The action-owned parser notes (a dropped concern, a malformed risk) are recorded in the run-directory artifact confidence-score.json and never reach the published body.
unavailable.later_review_linkage: A later review's finding outcome is recorded only in the run-directory artifact finding-outcomes.json, which carries no reference to the verifier's answer, so nothing published links a later finding to the verifier.
